commands.review_summary:
The PR adds Linux Cursor CLI usage support by routing Cursor through the local app auth token in the XDG Cursor state database, updating docs/storage footprint metadata, and adding Linux-focused coverage.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: the PR compiles CursorStatusProbe.swift on Linux while its sqlite3 calls still do not import the package's Linux CSQLite3 shim. The unguarded TestsLinux suite is also source-reproducible against the package/test runner layout.
commands.review_followup: - The remaining blockers are narrow mechanical repairs in the Cursor probe import guard and Linux test gating.

target.title: feat(linux): support Cursor provider via app auth token
target.body:
## Summary

Enables `codexbar usage --provider cursor` on Linux by reading the signed-in Cursor app's access token from the XDG config state database and reusing the existing `cursor.com` usage endpoints.

Fixes the current Linux CLI behavior:

```
Error: Cursor is only supported on macOS.
```

## Approach

- Resolve Linux `state.vscdb` at `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb` (default `~/.config/Cursor/...`)
- Keep macOS browser cookie import and WebKit login flow unchanged
- On Linux, auth order is: manual cookie header → cached session → Cursor app access token
- Allow Linux CLI routing for Cursor instead of rejecting all web-source fetches up front

## Review feedback addressed

- [x] Gate macOS-only `CursorCookieImporter` helpers behind `os(macOS)`
- [x] Use an empty browser import order on non-macOS Linux builds
- [x] Move Linux Cursor tests into `TestsLinux/CursorLinuxTests.swift`

## Behavior proof (Debian Linux, Cursor signed in)

Validated locally against the same Cursor app-auth + `cursor.com` API flow this PR implements.

```text
$ codexbar usage --provider cursor
== Cursor (...) ==
Total: 58% left [=====-------]
Auto: 52% left [======------]
API: 76% left [===---------]
Resets Jul 26 at 2:04PM
Account: ***@***
Plan: Pro
```

```json
{
  "provider": "cursor",
  "usage": {
    "primary": { "usedPercent": 42.26 },
    "secondary": { "usedPercent": 47.67 },
    "loginMethod": "Cursor Pro"
  }
}
```

## Test plan

- [x] Verified locally on Debian with Cursor installed and signed in
- [ ] `swift test --filter CursorLinuxTests` on Linux CI
- [ ] `codexbar usage --provider cursor --format json` on Linux after building this branch

## Notes

Automatic browser cookie import on Linux remains out of scope for this PR and can be a follow-up if SweetCookieKit paths are added.
